title: Low-degree norm comparison
statement:
Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose Fourier degree is at most $k$. If $1<p<2$, then
\[\|f\|_2\le \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{p-1}}\right)^k\|f\|_p,\]
where the norms are uniform norms on the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$
